description: This file defines a Java class 'MacroCallParameterIntegerValueMatcher' which extends Hamcrest's TypeSafeMatcher to provide custom matching logic for integer values, primarily used in unit testing assertions within the 'org.apache.ofbiz.widget.renderer.macro' package.

classes.name: MacroCallParameterIntegerValueMatcher
classes.description: A custom Hamcrest matcher that compares an object's value to a specified integer. It extends TypeSafeMatcher to facilitate assertions in tests involving integer comparison.

methods.name: MacroCallParameterIntegerValueMatcher
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the matcher with the integer value to compare against.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Checks whether the provided object equals the specified integer value.

methods.name: describeTo
methods.description: Describes the expected value in assertion failure messages.

methods.name: describeMismatchSafely
methods.description: Describes the mismatch when the item does not match the expected integer value.
